production_issue: JSON parsing failures caused by LLMs wrapping responses in markdown formatting fences, preamble/postamble conversational text, or prematurely completing the intake before the user could answer sector-specific questions.
unusual_logic: Enforces strict INTENT_CHANGED triggers to ignore semantic drift; implements a delayed is_complete=false gate when sector-specific questions are first displayed; uses strong negative rules to prevent markdown code block formatting.
why_not_remove: Removing these instructions causes standard JSON parsing exceptions when receiving fenced markdown, or allows onboarding to close early without capturing vital sector data required for high-quality matchmaking.
